name: Seiseki Yuushuu na Oshiego wa Ecchi na Obenkyou mo Chou Yuushuu!
original_name: 成績優秀な教え子はエッチなお勉強も超優秀!
source:
A loveable little girl who you are tutoring at home suddenly says 

"I want to watch you sperm."

What a precocious little thing! A true student of the world, she tackles the sex lesson with interest.
